root_cause: Email execution was sequentially coupled to other commercial intelligence stages; when an earlier stage failed, scheduled eligible outreach never reached its existing dispatcher. The all-connection daily enrichment was not called in the hourly commercial job.
change: In-place cron.alter_job, no new owner or duplicate sender; once-per-local-date full graph enrichment; main commercial cycle; guarded email-only fallback if the main cycle raises an exception.
honesty_boundary: Dispatch request ID is not a provider-delivered email. Only immutable Gmail provider ID plus independent SENT readback proves actual send.
protections: Never bypass recipient permission, suppression, contact-pressure, cooldown, valid recipient, human_approved, quality, canonical idempotency, or provider readback.
Never dispatch email fallback if main cycle completed (main cycle already owns e-mail dispatch).
Never create second cron, campaign or CRM.
closure: protected merge and exact main readback
next cron.job_run_details status and stage receipt
real eligible recipient plus immutable Gmail SENT readback
